verdict.rationale: Starting an online filing flow without an account is a fair question for a government tax portal, so the axis applies. However, the pack never states that any core flow can be entered without credentials. The registration help splits applications into Part A and Part B and mentions generating a temporary User ID, but neither item says the flow starts without login or via a reference or file number. Generating a temporary ID is itself creating credentials, and the remaining items describe login-based filing. The income-tax probe concerns a different portal and only covers page readability, so it is not relevant.
